lines.text: Could you pay a R10,000 emergency today, from savings?
A JustMoney survey of over 5,400 South Africans this year found fewer than one in five could.
And it's not only low earners. Even among people earning over R35,000 a month, 57% could not.
43% need to borrow before month-end, just to cover living costs.
So when an emergency hits, it gets paid with borrowed money.
The fix starts small. Aim for a first R2,000, in a separate savings account.
R200 a month gets you there in 10 months.
Then keep building, towards three to six months of your essential costs.
The full emergency fund guide is on the channel. Follow for a new money rule every day.
So, could you pay a R10,000 emergency today?
